# AURA | Next-Gen Social & Sustainable E-Commerce

A world-class e-commerce platform featuring Real-Time Social Carts, Carbon Footprint Tracking, and Digital Product Passports. Built to be better than Amazon.

## 🌟 Features
- 🛒 **Real-Time Social Cart:** Group buying with dynamic tiered discounts via WebSockets.
- 🌱 **Carbon Tracker:** Green delivery choices with live CO₂ impact meters.
- 🔐 **Glassmorphism Auth:** Premium login/signup experience.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack
- **Frontend:** HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, Socket.io
- **Hosting:** Vercel (Frontend), Localhost + Ngrok (Backend)
